storyCards.headline: Highway Don't Care: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Tim Mcgraw's "Highway Don't Care" reached #22 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Highway Don't Care" is a song by the American country music singers Tim McGraw and Taylor Swift, featuring Australian country singer Keith Urban on guitar.

The song peaked at #22 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Highway Don't Care was released in 2013.
